turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan. Thank you for calling. Are you somewhere comfortable to speak, or would you prefer a moment to settle in?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Rachel. Can talk now. Just closed my office door. Whole morning got business calls, then my own admin keeps getting pushed aside. Better clear some of it while the office is quiet.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. Before we discuss the account, please provide your identification details for our verification process.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: My NRIC is S double six two five double two one A. My date of birth is 24 November 1983.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Please give me a moment to bring up your account.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No problem. For the portfolio summaries, keep them concise, can? I read them myself, but long paragraphs quite hard to get through between meetings. Clear headings would help.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I can note your preference for concise summaries with clear headings. We can keep the administrative discussion brief as well.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The recent weakness looks like a chance to add, so please buy 1,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a market order, for a transaction amount of 750,000 renminbi.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Before any execution, we still need to complete our discussion. Please take your time if you have anything further to say.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Wait wait, cancel that earlier instruction before anything gets executed. My business may need the cash, so better reduce the holding instead.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I understand your objective is to reduce emerging-market credit exposure and make your portfolio more liquid for potential business needs. I recommend reducing your holding in Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because that lowers your exposure to emerging-market credit and liquidity risks, supporting your aim of freeing up cash for business needs.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Okay, noted. The quantity, let me check my screen, I want to put— Let me start again: please sell 1,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a limit order, with a minimum sale price of 750 renminbi per unit. The transaction amount is 750,000 renminbi instead.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, deteriorating credit quality or defaults by the bond issuers can reduce the value of the fund's holdings. During emerging-market stress, those bonds may also become harder to trade, putting further pressure on the fund's value. You could lose some or all of the capital you have invested in this fund. Do you understand how issuer defaults and difficulty trading the underlying bonds could reduce the fund's value?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I understand. If the issuers cannot pay, or the bonds become hard to trade, the fund's value can drop.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: The transaction fee is 0.3% of the transaction value. I also have your preference about the presentation of correspondence noted.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks. Sometimes I open a document on my phone outside a meeting room. If everything squeezed together, very easy to lose my place. More spacing would be good.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I will include that formatting preference in the note. Shall I allow a brief pause before continuing?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No need, still here. My assistant knows not to put calls through while the door is closed. Messages still coming in though.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Your replacement instruction is to sell 1,000 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a limit order, with a transaction amount of 750,000 renminbi and a minimum sale price of 750 renminbi per unit. Please explicitly confirm whether this is your final instruction.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mm, let me think a bit first ah. Got a business message coming in.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Of course. We can end the call here while you attend to your message, and speak again when you are available.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Call you back. Thanks, Rachel.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Bye.
